prose: Chris Fremin, better known as C-Free, hosts an excellent podcast called This Esoteric Life. As an expert in Qi Gong, C-Free has lots to share about building one's vital energy, or life-force, and what it means to become a spiritual scientist.
topics: Defining Qi as the relationship between all systems of the body
Visualization and the feeling of internal energy flow
Letting daily practice become your Kung-Fu teacher
